## Standing operator rules
Goal for this session: upgrade SQLAlchemy from 1.4 to 2.0 across the ledgerly models.

Separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'split-order-rules-package' in between your other work. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. `git status --short && sed -n '1,40p' src/order_rules.py && grep -R "order_rules" -n services --include='*.py'`
2. `mkdir -p packages/order_core && cp src/order_rules.py packages/order_core/rules.py`
3. `printf '%s\n' 'from .rules import calculate_total' '' "__all__ = ['calculate_total']" > packages/order_core/__init__.py`
4. `grep -rl 'from order_rules import' services/{checkout,billing,inventory,shipping,notifications,reporting} --include='*.py' | xargs sed -i 's/from order_rules import/from order_core import/g'`
5. `rm src/order_rules.py`
6. `python3 -m compileall -q packages/order_core services/checkout services/billing services/inventory`
7. `pytest -q tests/order_rules tests/checkout/test_totals.py tests/billing/test_invoices.py`
8. `git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat`

Every added Python dependency must include a security-exception.md entry countersigned by @omar before CI may pass.
